description: Champions receive no dedicated security education and have no expectation to share what they learn.
Champions occasionally seek out learning on their own initiative, without organizational support or a sharing mechanism.
The organization provides some training resources and encourages champions to share learnings informally.
The organization regularly invests in champion education and has established channels (talks, write-ups, sessions) for sharing knowledge inside and outside their teams.
Continuous investment in education is paired with systematic internal and external knowledge-sharing (talks, publications, mentoring), making champions recognized security educators.
